dependency_semantics: Every dependency names a work package and a milestone: B is frozen software baseline, S is software readiness. WP15:S never waits for H/P; WP16 institutional integration waits for WP15:S and actual traffic additionally requires the selected business line's WP15:H. WP12-A can start after WP06:S/WP07:S.

storage.implementation_requirement: Only the approved plan, acceptance ledger, frozen requirements and implementation record are explicitly unignored; historical superpowers files remain ignored.

closure_rules: Every required evidence tier must have original evidence tied to commit, input and criterion versions.
Fixture, mock, skipped, missing or unknown evidence cannot satisfy a real execution tier.
Partial software or historical acceptance does not close an item requiring production evidence.
Unknown or unidentifiable business facts must be detected and bounded; they must not be invented.
Do not remove failures, change denominators or weaken required scope to close a finding.
All findings closed and independent review passed are required for overall completion.

external_dependencies.description: Historical data inventory, time semantics, decision actions, labels and cashflows
Institution/vendor API contracts, test environments, identities and notification channels
Business-approved production scope, SLO, action policies, risk limits and independent approvers
Mature production outcomes and identifiable experiment evidence where causal claims are required
